test_title: PYST 99: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 10 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PENALTY : QFOBMUZ :: OFFENSE : PGGFOTF :: NERVOUS : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: Addition of +1 in all the letter.**

1) PENALTY : QFOBMUZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c728b07e06b30ed069a72206c16ba87dfe6d00999d58feb854be67d2ff8e5322.png] 

And,

2) OFFENSE : PGGFOTF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d5388d6f05d528887535d3c7969afebcefb591da5729706b654f12596f3d6ed.png] 

Similarly,

3) NERVOUS : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0dd5a876d4d58a4020c665a4bb871be2a2194fbd9c71eb10a7ffd07c3a1a74a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OFSWPVT".**
